tlvRequest.description: TLV-formatted string, length must be at least 6

applicationIdentifierTag4F.description: EMV Tag 4F - identifies the application as described in [ISO 7816-5]

applicationLabelTag50.description: EMV Tag 50 - this tag typically contains a label or name associated with the card application

issuerScriptTemplateOneTag71.description: EMV Tag 71 - value returned from authorization

issuerScriptTemplateTwoTag72.description: EMV Tag 72 - value returned from authorization

applicationInterchangeProfileTag82.description: EMV Tag 82 - value used to indicate the capabilities of the card to support specific functions within the application

dedicatedFileNameTag84.description: EMV Tag 84 - indicates the selected Application Identifier (AID) used in the transaction request

authorizationResponseCodeTag8A.description: EMV Tag 8A - generated by the authorization authority for an approved transaction

issuerAuthenticationDataTag91.description: EMV Tag 91 - contains data sent to the chip card for online issuer authentication

terminalVerificationResultsTag95.description: EMV Tag 95 - indicates the status of the different functions as seen from the terminal

transactionDateTag9A.description: EMV Tag 9A - used to indicate the local date that the transaction was authorized

transactionStatusInformationTag9B.description: EMV Tag 9B - indicates the functions performed in a transaction

transactionTypeTag9C.description: EMV Tag 9C - indicates the type of financial transaction, represented by the first two digits of the ISO 8583 processing code

applicationExpirationDateTag5F24.description: EMV Tag 5F24 - used to identify the date after which the application expires

transactionCurrencyCodeTag5F2A.description: EMV Tag 5F2A - used to indicate the currency code of the transaction according to the ISO 4217 standard

languagePreferenceTag5F2D.description: EMV Tag 5F2D - used to identify the language preference

applicationPanSequenceNumberTag5F34.description: EMV Tag 5F34 - used to differentiate chip cards using the same Primary Account Number (PAN)

accountTypeTag5F57.description: EMV Tag 5F57 - used to identify the account type

authorizedAmountTag9F02.description: EMV Tag 9F02 - used to indicate the authorized amount of the transaction (excluding adjustments)

otherAmountTag9F03.description: EMV Tag 9F03 - used to indicate a secondary “Cashback” amount associated with the transaction

applicationIdentifierTerminalTag9F06.description: EMV Tag 9F06 - used to identify the Application Identifier (AID), Terminal used in the transaction request

applicationVersionNumberTag9F09.description: EMV Tag 9F09 - taken from the application (application specific data)

issuerApplicationDataTag9F10.description: EMV Tag 9F10 - used to send proprietary application data to the issuer in an online transaction

issuerApplicationDataTag9F12.description: EMV Tag 9F12 - preferred mnemonic associated with the AID

terminalCountryCodeTag9F1A.description: EMV Tag 9F1A - used to identify the country code where the terminal is located

interfaceDeviceSerialNumberTag9F1E.description: EMV Tag 9F1E - Unique and permanent serial number assigned to the interface device by the manufacturer

transactionTimeTag9F21.description: EMV Tag 9F21 - local time that the transaction was authorised

applicationCryptogramTag9F26.description: EMV Tag 9F26 - returned by the Chip (ICC) in response to a “Generate AC” command"

cryptogramInformationDataTag9F27.description: EMV Tag 9F27 - indicates the type of cryptogram and the actions to be performed by the terminal

terminalCapabilitiesTag9F33.description: EMV Tag 9F33 - indicates the card data input, CVM, and security capabilities of the terminal

cardholderVerificationMethodResultsTag9F.description: EMV Tag 9F34 - used to indicate the results of the last CVM preformed

terminalTypeTag9F35.description: EMV Tag 9F35 - used to indicate the environment of the terminal, its communication capability, and its operational control

applicationTransactionCounterTag9F36.description: EMV Tag 9F36 - an incrementing counter value that is managed by the application in the chip card

unpredictableNumberTag9F37.description: EMV Tag 9F37 - used to provide variability and uniqueness to the generation of a cryptogram

transactionSequenceCounterTag9F41.description: EMV Tag 9F41 - Counter maintained by the terminal that is incremented by one for each transaction

transactionCategoryCodeTag9F53.description: EMV Tag 9F53 - Usually provided by the acquirer

issuerScriptResultsTag9F5B.description: EMV Tag 9F5B - used to identify the results of the terminal script processing

thirdPartyDataTag9F6E.description: EMV Tag 9F6E - contains indicators about the attributes of the card holder’s device and the technology used for communication between the cardholder’s device and the acquiring POS Device

customerExclusiveDataTag9F7C.description: EMV Tag 9F7C - available for the Issuer’s discretionary use. The issuer is responsible for ensuring its use of the field complies with all applicable laws and its own privacy policy

cardholderNameTag5F20.description: EMV Tag 5F20 - used to identify the card holder
